metas.name: 2026 · I Play Rocky
metas.description: A failing actor writes the ultimate underdog story and must fight for his chance to play the role of a lifetime - Rocky Balboa.

metas.name: 2026 · Norm: The Tale of Norm MacDonald
metas.description: Judd Apatow's documentary on Norm Macdonald uses archival footage, photos, and home videos to chronicle the SNL legend's career—from "Weekend Update" anchor to master of absurd, deadpan comedy whose influence endures.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2026 · You Can See Everything
metas.description: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait becomes a mind-bending three-year journey.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: 2026 · The Social Reckoning
metas.description: Follows Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, who enlisted the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to blow the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Unabomber
metas.description: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · Primetime
metas.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.
